hook.text: Even to your old age I am he, and to your gray hairs I will carry you. I made you, and I will bear you; I will carry you and I will rescue you.

hook.note: Every word of that verse is our Father speaking, so on the page you are holding it is blue from end to end. Psalm 34:18 tells you He is near the brokenhearted; this one is Him saying it, to you, about the exact season this edition was set for. That is the difference the color makes, and it is the reason the type being readable matters.

short350: The Bible you can read without reaching for glasses, holding it at arm's length, or giving up after a page.

This is the complete Father's Heart Bible set in large print — a fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek, made so you can hear God as He truly is: not a distant deity, but your Father.
Nothing was cut to make room for the bigger type. All 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,085 verses. All 1,354 study notes. And the full Divine Voice Color on every page.

That color is the part no other large print Bible has. Our Father's words are printed in blue, the Son's in red, the Spirit's in purple — so you can see at a glance which words a divine person spoke, and which person spoke them. For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, 125,457 words across 5,623 verses, and until now those words were printed in the same ink as the genealogies.
It is a natural gift for a parent or a grandparent, and a practical one for anyone who reads for long stretches — at a desk, in a chair, from a pulpit, or out loud to someone else.

Inside you will find a presentation page for a name, opening pages on intimacy, identity, inheritance and hearing His voice, an introduction to every one of the 66 books, and a Father's note closing each one with a short prayer.
Three cover colors — Charcoal, Plum and White — in paperback or hardback.

The text itself is free. Every word can be read online at no cost, and the reader there can be set to any size you like. Print exists for the people who want to hold it, mark it, and hand it to someone.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

body: Most large print Bibles ask for a trade. The notes go. The cross references go. Sometimes the text itself is abridged, and what arrives is a reading Bible rather than a Bible.

This one keeps all of it: the complete translation, all 1,354 study notes across 777 chapters, every book introduction and every Father's note. The only thing that changed is the size of the type — and, as a consequence, the thickness of the book at 1,016 pages.

long.h: The Only Large Print Bible in Divine Voice Color
body: Our Father's words in blue. The Son's in red. The Spirit's in purple. Genesis to Revelation, in full color on every page — not a red-letter New Testament with a black Old Testament, and not a color section at the back.
The color does more work at this size than it does at any other. When the type is large and the page is open on a table, you can see the shape of a conversation before you have read a word of it.
Reading glasses are a gift someone tolerates. A Bible they can actually read is a gift they open.
There is a presentation page inside the front for a name and a date, and the hardback in Charcoal, Plum or White is built to survive years of daily handling.
Large print is not only for aging eyes. It is what you want when you are reading to a room, to a class, to a congregation, or to one person in a hospital chair.
The larger measure and the voice colors together make it far easier to keep your place and to know, without hunting, who is speaking in the passage you are reading aloud.

faq.a: It is set larger throughout than the regular 6 x 9 edition, which is what takes the book from 876 pages to 1,016. Rather than take our word for the size, open Look inside above — the sample pages are rendered from the actual print file, so what you see is the type you will hold.

faq.q: Was anything left out to make room for the larger type?
faq.a: No. All 66 books, 1,189 chapters and 31,085 verses are here, along with all 1,354 study notes, every book introduction and every Father's note. The book is thicker instead — that is the whole trade.

faq.q: Is this the same translation as the regular edition?
faq.a: Word for word, yes. Same fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek, same 170 translation rules, same Divine Voice Color. The only difference between them is the size of the type and the number of pages.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for a parent or grandparent?
faq.a: It is the most common reason people buy it. There is a presentation page inside the front for a name and a date, and the hardback is built for years of daily handling. Charcoal and Plum are the usual choices for a gift.

Hardback if it is a gift or it will be handled every day; the case laminate holds up better over years. Paperback if you want it lighter in the hand or you are buying several. The interior is identical.
